principles: no claim without claim_evidence or explicit UNVERIFIED status
no financial amount without period, source document and locator
no framework document treated as constitutive law unless it actually is
institutional self-description stored separately from documented fact
derived metrics must expose formula and input observation IDs
unknown values remain null; never infer merely to complete a row
historical claims carry valid_from/valid_to where known
contradictions are recorded, not silently reconciled
every imported or transformed record retains provenance

documented_fact: at least one supporting primary/independent source
source locator present where document pagination/clauses allow
sidonie_analysis: input claim IDs or observation IDs present
